Partly. The JRC map doesn't show the loss itself. It is a 2020 forest/non-forest reference, so it only shows that the affected area was forest at the end of 2020. JRC GFC2020 agrees on 100% of the event area.

The 2023 loss comes from Hansen/UMD, which mapped about 0.7 ha (1.2% of the 58.1 ha asset). Because a later year (up to 2025) was observed and JRC agrees, the method marks the loss as supported.

The MGAP 2021 map shows 0.4 ha of the area as planted eucalyptus and 0.3 ha outside mapped forest, with no native forest. This is context only.

An additional 0.4 ha of loss in patches under 0.5 ha was not counted as an event.

This does not establish deforestation, cause, legality, responsible actor, or compliance. Hansen loss includes plantation harvest.
